title: Coral Pink Chanderi Kurta Set with Hand-Embroidered Yoke & Cutwork Dupatta
color_custom: Coral pink with pink & gold hand embroidery
description:
Soft coral, quiet shimmer and a yoke that catches the light. This chanderi kurta set is finished by hand with a jewel-like yoke of thread embroidery, mirror detailing and beadwork, framed by a delicate gota border. A light chanderi dupatta with a scalloped cutwork edge completes the look – graceful for festive lunches, pujas and day weddings.

✦ The Details
• Straight-cut chanderi kurta with a round neck and hand-embroidered yoke
• Thread embroidery, mirror detailing and beadwork, framed by a gota border
• 3/4 sleeves with embroidered cuffs, side slits, calf length
• Matching cotton straight pants with an elastic back waist and side pocket
• Chanderi dupatta with a scalloped cutwork edge
• 3-piece set: kurta, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
The kurta is chanderi with a soft cotton lining, so it has chanderi's gentle sheen without being see-through, and stays comfortable on the skin. The pants are cotton for all-day ease. The yoke is embroidered by hand, so tiny variations are part of its handmade character.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Pearl studs, a satin clutch and embellished flats for Diwali puja or a festive lunch. For a day wedding, add silver jhumkas and drape the dupatta on one shoulder to show off the yoke. Abroad, a camel or ivory coat looks lovely over the coral.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
